info.name: Data AVAX Supply EVM Balances API

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: The block number, if not defined the block number will be the latest block.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

params.name: address
params.description: A wallet address.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency that return values should use. Defaults to USD.

items.docs:
Gets native token balance of a wallet address.

Balance at a given block can be retrieved with the `blockNumber` parameter.

params.name: blockNumber
params.description: The block number, if not defined the block number will be the latest block.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 500.

params.name: filterSpamTokens
params.description: whether to filter out spam tokens from the response. Default is true.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

params.name: address
params.description: A wallet address.

params.name: contractAddresses
params.description: A comma separated list of contract addresses to filter by.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency that return values should use. Defaults to USD.

items.docs:
Lists ERC-20 token balances of a wallet address.

Balance at a given block can be retrieved with the `blockNumber` parameter.

Balance for specific contracts can be retrieved with the `contractAddresses` parameter.
